name: control-surface-sy181-15k3e-2.0.1
attribution: Fork of EpicLPer's CH552-OpenMacroPad, on Stefan Wagner's (wagiminator) CH55x USB HID code
flash: wchisp flash <file> (ROM bootloader 4348:55e0; config registers untouched)
knownIssues: Raw mode (CMD_RAW_MODE) ends 0-256 ms after every heartbeat: SDCC 4.5 compiled PAD_tick((uint8_t)(now - last)) without the truncation, so every wrap of the 8-bit millisecond counter passed ~65 s. With the daemon in raw input this lost key presses and knob detents and left holds stuck. The keymap (evdev) path is unaffected. Fixed in 2.0.2; the daemon refuses raw mode with 2.0.1.
A command that arrives while the previous one is still being handled is dropped (no reply). Fixed in 2.0.2.
notes: Built reproducibly, host-tested (fw_logic, fw_store) and verified on hardware.

hardwareVerification.flashMethod: CMD_BOOTLOADER from 2.0.0 (no key hold), wchisp Verify OK
hardwareVerification.details: Top knob, one revolution each: slow cw 20, fast cw 20, fast ccw 20 in the capture; GET_STATS cw 40 / ccw 20, missed states 0, overruns 0, tap-queue drops 0, deepest queue 1. Keys and knob presses were verified on 2.0.0; their code path is unchanged in 2.0.1. Raw mode was not verified on 2.0.1 and is broken (see knownIssues): measured lifetimes 82/202/204/207 ms for timeouts of 200/1500/5000/10000 ms.
